# PixelToolkit

> PixelToolkit is a browser-based image utility website developed by DigvijayEconLab. It is designed for Android phones and desktop browsers. Common implemented image operations run in the user's browser.

## Website links

- [Open PixelToolkit](https://pixel-toolkit.pages.dev/)
- [About PixelToolkit](https://pixel-toolkit.pages.dev/about.html)
- [Contact PixelToolkit](https://pixel-toolkit.pages.dev/contact.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://pixel-toolkit.pages.dev/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://pixel-toolkit.pages.dev/terms.html)

## Implemented image operations

The current application includes browser-side functionality for common image tasks, including:

- Image resizing and basic compression.
- Cropping, rotating, and flipping.
- Borders and padding.
- Blur and pixelation.
- Brightness and contrast adjustments.
- Text overlays and watermarks.
- Collage creation.
- Basic image metadata inspection and color sampling.
- Output format conversion where supported by the browser.

## Important feature limitations

The tool directory also contains planned or dependency-required entries. Not every listed tool is currently implemented. AI background removal, AI upscaling, image restoration, some document conversions, and other advanced entries may require additional modules, models, or libraries. Browser format support and output quality vary by device, browser, source file, and selected settings.

## Privacy and processing

Core browser-based image operations are designed to process selected files locally on the user's device. Users should review the [Privacy Policy](https://pixel-toolkit.pages.dev/privacy.html) and the requirements shown by an individual tool before using it with sensitive material.

## How to use PixelToolkit

1. [Open the PixelToolkit website](https://pixel-toolkit.pages.dev/).
2. Select an available tool.
3. Choose an image from the device.
4. Adjust the available settings and process the image.
5. Review the result before downloading it.
